spacr.metal_cellpose: Keep Cellpose's CPU-only augmentation/AMP assumptions off the Metal path.
spacr.metal_cellpose.training_context:
Augment on CPU, train in float32 on Metal, and restore upstream globals.

Cellpose 4.2 builds float64 affine tensors and enters unsupported MPS
autocast. Only its training-module references are adapted; the torch module
and other application code are untouched. Network forward/backward stays
on the selected GPU. Older Cellpose releases lacking this seam are retained.
spacr.mps_reduce:
Opt-in Metal reducers with sklearn-shaped results and bounded working memory.

Cluster assignment, centroid updates and well-conditioned PCA projections run
on MPS. PCA fitting and numerically sensitive projections use CPU float64:
forming a float32 covariance matrix can erase valid scientific components.
spacr.mps_reduce.MetalKMeans: Lloyd KMeans with chunked Metal assignment and k-means++ initialization.
spacr.mps_reduce.MetalPCA: Stable CPU PCA fitting with Metal projection where precision permits.
spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview._segment_m: Discard complete labels intersecting the calibrated crop's boundary.
spacr.torch_loader:
Transport macOS loader batches without PyTorch shared-memory daemons.

On Intel macOS, torch 2.2's file-system sharing helpers inherit Python's
resource-tracker pipe. Python then waits for that tracker while the helpers
wait for Python to exit. Default collation sends NumPy-backed records instead;
the parent restores the same CPU tensor shapes and dtypes before yielding.
spacr.torch_loader.ArrayDataLoader:
Default CPU batches cross process boundaries as NumPy, then restore.

Explicit custom collators retain their existing behavior. Single-process
loaders use ordinary PyTorch collation and iteration unchanged.
